PETROBIND QUALITY CONTROL PROCESS

6-stage document and qualification workflow applied before shipment confirmation.

01

RFQ SPECIFICATION REVIEW

Grade, quantity, destination, incoterm, packaging, and tender test-method requirements are checked before quoting.

02

COA AND PDS MATCHING

Available lots are compared against buyer requirements using COA and PDS values from qualified supply sources.

03

METHOD VERIFICATION

Key values such as penetration, softening point, viscosity, ductility, and flash point are reviewed against ASTM, ISO, EN, or project methods.

04

BUYER QUALIFICATION

PetroBind provides specification data for buyer technical review before commercial confirmation.

05

LOADING AND PACKING RECORDS

Packing type, lot references, container details, seals, and loading records are coordinated for shipment traceability.

06

DOCUMENT SET ISSUED

COA, PDS where requested, MSDS/SDS, packing list, origin documents, and transport documents are prepared for import use.

MATERIAL SAFETY (MSDS SUMMARY)

GHS-aligned SDS overview; full documents available per grade on request.

PRODUCT IDENTITY

Petroleum bitumen / air-blown bitumen. CAS: 8052-42-4 (bitumen, oxidized).

COMPOSITION

Complex mixture of high-boiling hydrocarbons derived from petroleum crude vacuum distillation and/or air-blowing.

HAZARDS SUMMARY

Molten material: risk of thermal burns. Fumes at elevated temperatures may cause irritation. Cooled solid: low acute hazard.

FIRST AID

Skin contact (hot): cool rapidly with cold water, seek medical attention. Eye/Inhalation: move to fresh air; irrigate eyes; seek medical advice if symptoms persist.

HANDLING / STORAGE

Store drums indoors or under cover, away from open flame and strong oxidizers. Molten storage temperature in line with grade-specific softening point guidance.

TRANSPORT CLASS

Not classified as dangerous goods under IMDG / IATA for ambient shipments; molten bulk may apply additional clauses depending on temperature.

DISPOSAL

Dispose of waste and contaminated packaging via licensed contractor, in accordance with local / national environmental regulations.

FULL MSDS

Complete SDS (GHS / OSHA format) available on written request. Contact PetroBind export desk with grade and language preference.
